data.probe: --agent is the global flag; the review subparser declares no --agent option (its flags are gate/intent/context/base/commit/branch/chunk/delta/full/detach/exclude/include-pinned/force/reason/finding/...), so '--agent before review' is the only valid placement and scanning to the '--' delimiter (matching _relaunch_argv) is sufficient; there is no reviewer-owned --agent after the subcommand
